verdictScope: Only the eight assigned saved surfaces: all five desktop images, mobile whole course, mobile initial viewport, and mobile figure 51.
summary: The assigned surfaces have readable initial views, coherent course composition and complete, nonoverlapping figure clips. The rendered English prose and boundaries match the previously reviewed repaired draft. Tall whole-course images were viewer-downscaled, so their PASS is bounded composition evidence, not exhaustive fine-glyph or full-resolution approval. Mobile figure 52/53 clips remain unopened and pending a fresh reviewer batch.

englishApplicability.observation: The current English definitions, RMS caveats, apparatus terminology, wall-shift references and Brownian limitations apply to these composed views. No new translation, scientific, source-fidelity, geometry or original-figure approval was performed. The first review and affected-only PASS remain preserved.

captionRecovery.technicalCause: The former .figcap allTextContents comparison flattened KaTeX MathML, annotation and visible HTML text together, yielding ttt, and compared flattened whitespace against the source newline and $t$ notation.
captionRecovery.method: The saved helper clones caption nodes, replaces each KaTeX subtree in the clone with its annotation in math delimiters, and compares against expected captions with whitespace normalization. Both saved views have empty errors and the report has no failure.
captionRecovery.observation: The comparison fix does not rewrite the lesson or displayed caption HTML. The desktop whole view shows the two-line figure-53 explanation with a single visible time variable and no caption/prose overlap; no new browser or DOM check was run by this reviewer.

surfaces.observation: Continuous centered course column from heading to the completed Brownian footnote. Figures and captions are separated from surrounding prose; section rules distinguish the experiment and Brownian topics. No visible gross clipping, overlap or blank region. Whole-view downscale limits fine glyph conclusions.

Title and crumb have distinct space. Opening ideal/classical/equilibrium, mass, rest-view and kelvin definitions are readable, and the substitution and mean-square formula are visibly separated from text. RMS introduction continues normally at the viewport bottom. The legacy filename does not indicate a wrong-topic view.

Complete A/B labels, endpoints, dashed direct distance and solid zigzag; high contrast and clear separation without cropping or label collision. Applicable to the reviewed qualitative path/displacement explanation, not a measured trajectory.

Both panels, nested rims, A/B/C/O, literal R_A/R_B, panel a/b and static deposit D are complete, readable and nonoverlapping. The clip fits the repaired apparatus vocabulary. This does not replay the original radius/slit geometry proof.

Both panels and C/O/D/D-prime/s references are distinct. Dashed guides and arrowheads remain visible; no edge-cut label or obstruction. Applicable to the reviewed slit-crossing/arrival and wall-arc prose without renewed source or figure-science approval.

The overview shows continuous wrapped course material through the final footnote, with separated figure/caption regions and no visible gross sideways overflow or overlap. Strong downscaling means this is continuity/composition evidence only. The embedded figure 52/53 appearances do not certify their excluded individual mobile clips.

The title wraps cleanly to two lines and the crumb wraps below it without collision. Opening definitions and mean-square substitution are readable with side margins; math does not occlude prose. The one-molecule mass statement is complete, and later paragraphs continue below this ordinary viewport.

Entire zigzag and direct AB construction fit the saved mobile clip. A/B labels and endpoint dots are readable and distinct, with no edge loss or overlap. The first-figure English context remains applicable.
